informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 若奇数 n = ab 是晶体数，则它的分量 {a, b} 是唯一的：不存在另一对大于 1 的 c、d 也使 n = cd 成为晶体数。
informal_restatement.text_en:
If $n = ab$ is a crystal, then there are no other pairs of
positive integers $c, d > 1$, different from the couple $a, b$, such that $n = cd$ and
$B(c, d) ∈ ℕ$, i.e., the components of the crystals are unique.
